content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raipur Tele-MANAS Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Department of Psychiatry of All India Institute of Medical Sciences Raipur, G. E. Road, Tatibandh, Raipur-492 099 (CG). The posts are being filled for the Mentoring Institute of Chhattisgarh under the National Tele Mental Health Programme (Tele-MANAS), at AIIMS Raipur. The notice is signed by Dr. Lokesh Kumar Singh, Professor & HoD, Department of Psychiatry.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice prints no category-wise break-up of these posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same three desirable points for both posts, listed under each post below. The upper age limit for both posts is "Not exceeding 65 Yrs."; the application form counts age as on 30/11/2026. Vacancies: 01; pay Rs.150000; age not exceeding 65 Yrs. Desirable: clinical and/or research experience in Telemedicine and/or Tele-training. Desirable: experience of working with multidisciplinary research teams. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Nature of employment: purely on contractual basis for a period of 06 months from the date of joining, extendable depending on the performance of the candidate and at the discretion of the competent authority. No other or additional allowances other than the consolidated salary are admissible. The appointee is not entitled to the benefits available to regular employees of AIIMS Raipur. The appointment can be terminated at any time, on either side, by giving one month's notice or by paying one month's salary without assigning any reason, or on failure to complete the period of three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. The appointee performs the duties assigned, and the competent authority reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required, with no extra allowance. The appointee has no right or claim to appointment on regular basis at AIIMS Raipur on any post. The appointee is on whole-time appointment for the project and shall not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, or engage in private practice of any kind during the contract. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or written exam/test, or for joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raipur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications go by post and also through a Google Form. Both are required; an application not submitted through both modes will be rejected. Download the application form from the website of AIIMS Raipur and fill it in the prescribed format. No change in the serial number order or the column headings is allowed; annexures may be added as separate sheets if required. Attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates and the other documents listed below. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ................................" on the envelope. Send it by speed post or registered post only to: Department of Psychiatry, National Telemanas Project, Room No. 1989, B Block, 2nd Floor, New Administrative and Academic Building, Gate No. 05, AIIMS Raipur, Tatibandh, Raipur, Pin Code 492099. The application must be received on or before 30 November 2026 by 05:00 PM. The notice says it is the candidate's sole responsibility to track the application and that the undersigned is not responsible for any postal delay. Also fill the Google Form at https://forms.gle/oKeK6Z4zQsKF5BoQ7 . Eligible candidates must turn up with their original certificates on the date of the interview/test. No call letter will be issued separately. For further information, candidates may write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The applications are scrutinized by the selection committee. Recruitment is made through interview and, if necessary, a written test. The final decision on appointment rests with the competent authority only. If applications are many, the interview may spill over to the next day, a screening test may be held, or any other criteria may be adopted to shortlist candidates. The competent authority may adopt shortlisting criteria such as written test, experience, educational qualification or any other means. The list of candidates found eligible or shortlisted is displayed on the AIIMS Raipur website, and information is also given by email. The date, time and venue of the interview/test will be notified on the AIIMS Raipur website. No separate communication is sent about changes. The final result is declared on the AIIMS Raipur website, and selected candidates are informed through email.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled prescribed application form Photocopy of identification proof (Aadhar Card, Voter ID Card, Passport or any other Govt. identity proof) Self-attested certificates, mark sheets and degrees 10th mark sheet Experience certificates MCI/RCI registration certificate NOC (No Objection Certificate) for candidates working in a govt. organization Any other relevant document The application form also asks for a recent passport size photograph, educational qualification details, experience record, a list of research publications (if applicable), permanent and correspondence addresses, and the applicant's signature.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, applications without the prescribed format, or those received after the due date will not be considered. The application will not be accepted through any other means. If any declaration or information is found incorrect or false, or material information is wilfully suppressed, the candidate is liable for removal from service and other action. A candidate found canvassing for selection will be disqualified from the selection process. The decision of the competent authority is final and no representations will be entertained. Records related to this recruitment are preserved for six months, except records of selected candidates and matters pending in courts. Any dispute is subject to the court having jurisdiction over Raipur (CG).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Assistant Professor and 1 Senior Resident in the Department of Psychiatry under Tele-MANAS.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026, 05:00 PM. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: A post graduate Psychiatry qualification e.g., MD/ DNB/Diploma, plus three years' experience in a recognized institution in the Psychiatry after obtaining the qualifying degree of MD or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: A post graduate Psychiatry qualification e.g., MD/DNB/Diploma. The notice prints no experience requirement for this post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for both posts is "Not exceeding 65 Yrs." The application form counts age as on 30/11/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor gets Rs.150000 and Senior Resident gets Rs.100000. No other allowances beyond the consolidated salary are admissible.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the filled form with self-attested copies by speed post or registered post to the Department of Psychiatry, National Telemanas Project, Room No. 1989, B Block, 2nd Floor, New Administrative and Academic Building, Gate No. 05, AIIMS Raipur, Tatibandh, Raipur, Pin Code 492099. Also fill the Google Form.

faq.question: Q8. Is it enough to fill only the Google Form?
faq.answer: No. Applicants must submit through both the post and the Google Form, and an application not submitted through both modes will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through interview and, if necessary, a written test, after scrutiny by the selection committee. The competent authority may also shortlist by written test, experience or educational qualification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is TA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely contractual for 06 months, extendable at the discretion of the competent authority. No TA/DA is paid for the interview, test or joining.
